S019.name: Delusions
S019.description: Fixed beliefs that do not change easily, even in the face of contradictory evidence.

subtypes.Persecutory Delusions: The false belief that one is being harmed or monitored by other people or organizations.
subtypes.Referential Delusions: The conviction that ordinary events, remarks, or behaviors have specific relevance to oneself.
subtypes.Grandiose Delusions: The false belief that one possesses special abilities, power, or fame.
subtypes.Erotomanic Delusions: The false belief that another person is in love with or has affection for them.
subtypes.Nihilistic Delusions: A destructive or negative conviction that the world is ending or that a major catastrophe will occur.
subtypes.Somatic Delusions: The baseless conviction that there is a serious abnormality with one's body or organs.
subtypes.Jealous Delusions: The conviction that one's spouse or romantic partner is being unfaithful without sufficient evidence.

patient_info.stressor_event: Major changes in working hours or conditions
patient_info.stressor: Joselito’s long-stable IT role changed when his employer moved to a rotating hybrid schedule with after-hours support tickets, tighter cybersecurity rules, and less informal mentoring time with junior staff. During the following 1 year and 2 months, he formed a fixed belief about what was happening inside the workplace that did not shift even when supervisors provided logs, policy documents, and direct reassurance. He kept doing technically competent work, but the belief began to affect meetings, documentation, and his willingness to collaborate on certain network projects. He entered psychiatric care through an employee assistance referral after he requested mediation with management and his wife encouraged him to use the appointment to protect both his job and his peace at home.

S019.name: Delusions
S019.description: Fixed beliefs that do not change easily, even in the face of contradictory evidence.
S019.manifestation: I’m here because for over a year now I’ve been trying to get someone to take seriously that the new ticket rotation and security audits are being used to build a paper trail against me at work, even though management keeps showing me logs and saying it’s just policy.

additional_requirement_1.name: Additional Requirement 1
additional_requirement_1.description: Functioning is not markedly impaired apart from the impact of the delusion(s) or its ramifications
additional_requirement_1.manifestation: Outside of this issue with the ticket rotation and audits, I still keep my house in order, pay bills, help my wife, and handle the technical parts of my job without people saying my work is sloppy or disorganized.

functional_impairment.name: Functional Impairment
functional_impairment.manifestation: At work, I’ve started avoiding certain network projects and writing longer defensive notes in tickets, which has made meetings tense and slowed down collaboration with my team.

duration.name: Duration
duration.manifestation: This has been going on since the hybrid schedule and after-hours ticket changes started, about a year and two months ago.
